method: manual visual transcription of the printed copy from the exact supplied image paths using view_image(detail=original). All five native, five usage720 and five thumbnail320 images were actually viewed; all calls returned original detail, with no tool-level viewing failure. No OCR, crop, substitute image, web search, connector, peer file or production material was used. The six strings for each image were read from pixels at native and usage720; observed line breaks are retained where applicable and equality normalizes whitespace only. Thumbnail limitations are recorded separately and are not substituted for usage720 readings. review-protocol.md and the empty preflight.json were read first; the unchanged empty editorial-action-first.json was saved and read back before packet.json was opened. PNG headers of the exact fifteen supplied paths were read to verify dimensions: native ratios have 0% error; usage720 is 720 pixels wide, including 720x1080 portrait paths; thumbnail320 has a longest side of 320. Photo-like appearance and visible action are assessed, without certifying authorship, actual material composition, physical operation or print performance. Mandatory pass includes the requested same-structure condition across the five-member set; its failure is recorded on every member, independently of the successful copy and ratio checks.

uncertainties: Paper and viewing angle hide parts of the closed clips in other members; exact internal construction cannot be determined. The visibly different exposed silhouettes remain a product-consistency concern.
The open gap and fingertip contact demonstrate the intended action pictorially; spring force, attachment to cork and actual operation cannot be certified from these pixels.
